div.head: II Cn 28.1
div.ab: And nan man his men fram him ne tæce, ær he clæne sý ælcere spræce, þe he ær beclypod wæs.
And nan man his men fram him ne tace, ær he clæne sy ælcere sprece, þe he ær beclyped wæs.
Et nemo suum hominem a se dimittat, priusquam mundus sit in causis omnibus, quibus fuerat ante compellatus (ante fuerit accusatus).
⁊ nan man his men fram him ne tǽce, ær hé clǽne sy æt ælcere spǽce ðe he ær beclypad wæs.
And nan man his men fram him ne tæce ær he clæne sy ælcere spræce þe he ær beclypod wæs.
Und niemand weise seinen Untergebenen von sich, bevor dieser von jeder Klage rein sei, womit er früher beklagt gewesen ist.
And let no one dismiss his man from him before he is clear of every charge on which he was previously accused.
And no-one shall dismiss one of his men from his service until he is quit of every accusation which has been brought against him.
And no one is to dismiss his man, before he is cleared of every charge with which he had been accused.
And no one is to release one of his followers from service unless he has been shown to be innocent of any accusation that has been brought against him.
